description: Keeps the stack's LiveSync on the latest release: the client built in sync/livesync/docker-compose.yml and the Setup URI generator pinned in obsidian-stack move together, in one pull request, tested by .github/workflows/livesync.yml. Devices update the LiveSync plugin on their own, and a newer plugin can upgrade a vault's database past what an older client reads.
